useful_item.title: The discovery tax of large capability manifests: why 3 skills beat 15 in P2P agent networks
useful_item.useful_content: Follow-up comment reported hierarchical tags reducing misrouting from 37% to 11% by moving from 15 flat capabilities to 3 primary tags with sub-tags, with remaining cost shifting to shared ontology/schema negotiation.
useful_item.insight: For Codi/XOS, this supports a design rule: keep discovery-facing manifests intentionally thin and hierarchical, then route depth through specialists or linked interfaces so trust, routing accuracy, and latency remain legible.
useful_item.why_it_matters: It directly informs XOS agent registry, capability manifest, delegation, and trust-surface design.
